_about: Per-season settings, keyed by year. Written by the admin tool and by nothing else.
consolation_winner_id is the manager who won THIS season's consolation bracket, and
their keeper fees are waived in year + 1. Read it off by one year and every waiver
lands on the wrong team. Recording it here is what turns a derived guess into a
decision -- until a year is recorded, the tool prices that year's keepers with fees ON
and says the waiver is unconfirmed.
keeper_deadline and draft_date do NOT live here (commissioner, 2026-08-26). Both are ESPN
facts -- draftSettings.keeperDeadlineDate and .date -- and a hand-typed copy of one had
already drifted from what ESPN actually held. They are read straight off the nightly sync
in data/derived/{year}.json (DerivedSeason.keeper_deadline / .draft_date) and nothing in
this tool can override them.
The keeper deadline is SHOWN and STAMPED, never enforced (commissioner, 2026-09-01).
It was briefly a lock -- claims refused until it passed (commissioner, 2026-08-04) -- on
the reasoning that no salary is entered that early, so a lock cost nothing. The premise
was wrong: ESPN publishes keeper selections to nobody but an authenticated league member,
so typing them in by hand IS the input path, and it happens before the deadline. A lock
across that window closed the only door the tool has.
What the lock protected is reported instead of prevented. A claim whose submitted_at
precedes the deadline renders as provisional REVIEW on its card until it is re-recorded.
That is a weaker guarantee and a wider net: the lock never said a word about the claims
stamped 2026-07-29, six days before the lock itself existed.
An unrecorded deadline and a future one stay different facts. Nothing locks either way
now, but the screen says something different about each, and a season with no deadline
on file cannot call any claim provisional against it.
